panel_filesystem.title: File System Access Control
panel_filesystem.desc: 配置基于正则表达式的 AllowList 和 BanList 规则，控制文件系统工具可以访问的路径。
panel_filesystem.allowlist_desc: Regex patterns for paths that are explicitly allowed. One pattern per line. If empty, all non-banned paths are allowed.
panel_filesystem.banlist_desc: Regex patterns for paths that are always denied. One pattern per line. BanList takes precedence over AllowList.
panel_filesystem.msg_test_banned: 已阻止 - 匹配 BanList 规则: '{0}' (完整路径: {1})
panel_filesystem.msg_test_allowed_no_all: 已允许 - 未配置 AllowList。 (完整路径: {0})
panel_filesystem.msg_test_allowed_match: 已允许 - 匹配 AllowList 规则: '{0}' (完整路径: {1})
panel_filesystem.msg_test_blocked_no_mat: 已阻止 - 未匹配任何 AllowList 规则。 (完整路径: {0})
panel_filesystem.msg_reset: 表单已重置为默认值。点击 Save 以持久化。
